description: Source code for the 'Appointment' doctype in a Frappe/ERPNext application, managing appointment creation, verification, assignment, and related operations.

classes.name: Appointment
classes.description: Represents an appointment entity with methods for handling appointment lifecycle, verification, assignment, and calendar integration.

methods.name: find_lead_by_email
methods.description: Finds a lead by email address.

methods.name: find_customer_by_email
methods.description: Finds a customer by email address.

methods.name: before_insert
methods.description: Performs checks and linkages before inserting a new appointment.

methods.name: after_insert
methods.description: Handles post-insertion actions like creating calendar events or sending confirmation emails.

methods.name: send_confirmation_email
methods.description: Sends an email to confirm the appointment.

methods.name: on_change
methods.description: Syncs calendar event when appointment details change.

methods.name: set_verified
methods.description: Verifies email, creates lead if needed, and updates appointment status.

methods.name: create_lead_and_link
methods.description: Creates a new lead and links it to the appointment.

methods.name: auto_assign
methods.description: Automatically assigns the appointment to an available agent.

methods.name: get_assignee_from_latest_opportunity
methods.description: Retrieves the latest opportunity's assignee for the lead.

methods.name: create_calendar_event
methods.description: Creates a calendar event for the appointment.

methods.name: _get_verify_url
methods.description: Generates a verification URL for appointment confirmation.
